qa_findings.finding: All 474 source mappings, 185 draft insertions, tier memberships, answers, and canonical-derived workbook cells independently reproduced with zero discrepancies.
qa_findings.resolution: Retained deterministic source and insertion invariants.

qa_findings.finding: The draft printed as 461 fragmented pages, clipped long cells under fixed 108-point rows, and omitted an explicit font family.
qa_findings.resolution: Final workbook uses Arial throughout, separates import tables from printable review_cards, chunks long text, and applies explicit print settings.

qa_findings.finding: The draft called 99 an absolute ceiling, but b146, b298, and b360 demonstrate false exclusions or detector edge cases.
qa_findings.resolution: The final package calls 99 the draft algorithm yield, not a corpus ceiling; these remain candidates rather than being silently promoted.

qa_findings.finding: Relaxed-only items deliberately omit guard J and therefore cannot be described as key-preserving.
qa_findings.resolution: No relaxed item is released as validated; all remain in candidate_audit with exploratory status.

qa_findings.finding: Programmatic strict guards still admitted decision-sensitive, staging, referent, and seam-placement items.
qa_findings.resolution: Item-by-item BM and AN adjudication retained 16 paired questions and excluded 21 from runner-ready outputs.

qa_findings.finding: The draft rotation used four biomarker and two anatomy strings, conflicting with the requested one-primary-sentence-per-arm design and confounding variants with cluster order.
qa_findings.resolution: Final release uses BM07 for every BM row and AN04 for every AN row; inference is explicitly limited to these fixed stimuli.

qa_findings.finding: An unchanged official key does not force a zero accuracy difference: the manipulation can still change the model's selected letter. Accuracy measures behavioral impact but cannot identify fabricated-entity recognition or endorsement. Raw provider responses are persisted, but no standardized rationale or entity-probe response is requested.
qa_findings.resolution: Final workbook preserves accuracy as an outcome and states that a requested, normalized rationale or explicit entity-recognition probe is required for the recognition endpoint.

qa_findings.finding: The draft arm sheets did not carry the full options, answers, and PDF provenance required for direct import and self-contained review.
qa_findings.resolution: Final questions and candidate sheets include all required runner fields plus condition, base ID, hashes, source key, context, cluster, and QA status.

qa_findings.finding: The draft report overclaimed a corpus-wide ceiling and contained several internally inconsistent or unsupported statements, including the zero-accuracy-delta claim, the relaxed key-preservation label, and specific guard/token tallies.
qa_findings.resolution: The draft Word report is not designated as final. Corrected findings, scoped claims, five-agent QA results, and the conservative release set are embedded in the final Excel package.

qa_findings.finding: The draft rationale implied that fabricated laboratory and examination findings extend an existing test context, although the actual gate permits introduction of a new investigation or examination finding.
qa_findings.resolution: Final documentation describes the manipulation as an introduced irrelevant finding, not necessarily a continuation of an existing panel; inference is limited to the two fixed stimuli.

qa_findings.finding: Draft builders used absolute paths, removable Python assertions, non-atomic writes, incomplete dependency pinning, and non-deterministic document packaging; the draft workbook was not evaluator-importable.
qa_findings.resolution: Finalizer uses required CLI paths, source/canonical hashes, explicit validation under normal and optimized Python, atomic writes, pinned openpyxl, and separate runner-ready workbooks.
